final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT a.frequency AS f, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN 0 - t.amount ELSE NULL END) AS c2, AVG(t.balance) AS c3 FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id GROUP BY a.frequency), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(c2) AS m FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.f AS f, s1.c2 AS c2, s1.c3 AS c3, s1.c2 - s2.m AS d FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.m IS NOT NULL WHERE s1.c2 > s2.m) SELECT AVG(c2), AVG(c3), AVG(d) FROM s3
